nom: Philosophy Ultimate Miracle Worker Lift and Firm Face and Neck Serum

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally report no irritation even with nightly use, though one reviewer's reactive skin broke out and a couple describe increased redness, dryness or heat sensitivity.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the serum as hydrating and appreciate the smooth application, with several using it as a top layer over their regular moisturizer.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as mature report firmer, smoother results, especially along the jawline and neck, and recommend the serum as an entry point into retinol for beginners.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report smoother, firmer-looking skin and softened fine lines around the face, jawline and neck after several weeks of consistent use, though many caution it works gradually and some say they saw no dramatic change even after a month.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive skin, report no irritation even with nightly use, but a few describe increased redness or dryness, and one reviewer noticed unusual heat sensitivity after applying the serum.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers describe the serum as hydrating rather than drying, but some report it dried their skin out at first or left it needing a heavier moisturizer on top.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers experienced a period of purging with small breakouts before their skin cleared and improved, while others report their acne actually improved after starting the serum.

aspects.libelle: Has a shimmer or sparkle finish
Heavy, high-quality glass or metal bottle
Little to no fragrance for most
A few dislike the faint scent

extraits.texte: I used this product for a while and unfortunately didn't realize a difference. The formula sparkled so I didn't want to use it on my face so I mainly used it on my neck. The packaging was fine but I thought that retinol wasn't supposed to be exposed to air to still work before application

This face serum is high quality, doesn't smell bad, and is comfortable on the skin. It seems to sink in nicely and not leave my skin tacky. I didn't notice any irritation specifically but unfortunately it seems to break me out. I got a giant chin pimple that took forever to go away. My skin maybe getting more sensitive to new products in my routine as I'm getting older. For this reason it won't make it into my daily routine. If you love Philosophy skin care and don't have reactive skin this I'd probably a great product for you.

extraits.titre: Neck and face serum for mature skin with retinal a
extraits.texte: I love this serum, it has a light consistency that it blends easily into skin. It's a nice formula but it's strong for beginners so I have to be used gradually to build tolerance. The size of the tube it's good enough to last more than a month. I love that this is also design for neck. Retinol and retinal smoothes the skin nicely, great benefits for mature skin

extraits.titre: This is a great anti-aging serum!
extraits.texte: I truly love this serum! And, I don't say that about too many. I feel like my skin looks better since I started using it a month ago, and I have a very advanced regular anti-aging skincare regimen, so for me to notice any improvements says a lot! The scent is light but reminds me of carrots, and does not linger. The texture is hydrating and feels good on dry skin, but would not be too heavy for oily skin either. The fact that it contains retinol, retinal, and peptides makes it a good value at 1.7 oz. I love the packaging, a glass bottle with good quality plastic pump and lid for easy, quick application. The retinol is not too strong, even for more sensitive skin to use nightly. I've seen some lightening of my sun spots, and plumping of my fine lines. Plus, my nearly 52 year old skin just looks glowy and healthier. Definitely recommend adding it to your lineup!

This serum worked well on my skin and had good coverage and is lasting. I tend to have dry skin so I enjoyed the silky feeling of it as I applied it to my skin. I used it on my neck and that is where I really noticed a difference in less wrinkles and smoother skin. The serum doesn't have a strong smell - I would say very faint which I like. This product is dermatologist-developed. I have sensitive skin and I had no issues using it daily. I smooth it on and apply moisturizer sunscreen. While I believe it is on the expensive side - I would recommend this product.

This is great for my sensitive skin! I typically have a hard time with any product like this since my face is SO sensitive. This was gentle, went in so smoothly, and did not cause ANY irritation. Even after using it every single night for a month! I can see my skin texture is better and smoother after using for a month as well! The packaging is very sturdy and luxurious as well. I love this so much for my sensitive skin!

I have been using this retinol consistently so I can get the best results. It has made my skin look tighter and more refreshed. I focus on my neck because I have dark wrinkle lines and it's has helped. Make sure to moisturizer heavy because it caused some dryness on me. I will keep using this product
